title: A job listing shows Apple is developing an AI agent that can write code, browse the web, control apps, navigate devices, and coordinate subagents for users (Mark Gurman/Bloomberg)
summary: Mark Gurman / Bloomberg: A job listing shows Apple is developing an AI agent that can write code, browse the web, control apps, navigate devices, and coordinate subagents for users — Apple Inc. is developing its own autonomous artificial intelligence agent that can get things done on behalf of users …
